rules.name: Mobile — Insecure Data Storage on Device
rules.description: Detects mobile app data storage issues including unencrypted SQLite databases and shared preferences
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%data-storage%' OR payload ILIKE '%masvs%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile — Insecure Network Communication
rules.description: Detects mobile apps communicating over HTTP, using weak TLS, or accepting self-signed certificates
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%network%' OR payload ILIKE '%masvs%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile — Hardcoded Credentials in Binary
rules.description: Detects hardcoded credentials, API keys, or tokens in mobile app binaries or configuration files
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%hardcoded%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile — Local Privilege Escalation (Root/Jailbreak)
rules.description: Detects mobile app authorization bypass through rooted or jailbroken devices or debug modes
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authorization%' OR payload ILIKE '%root-detection%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile — Intent Spoofing and Deep Link Abuse
rules.description: Detects Android intent spoofing or iOS deep link abuse for unauthorized actions
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%intent-spoofing%' OR payload ILIKE '%deep-link%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile — Certificate Pinning Bypass
rules.description: Detects SSL/TLS certificate pinning bypass attempts on mobile applications
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%certificate-pinning%' OR payload ILIKE '%ssl%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile — Sensitive Data in Logs
rules.description: Detects sensitive data such as tokens, passwords, or PII logged by mobile applications in cleartext
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%logging%' OR payload ILIKE '%data-exposure%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile — Clipboard Data Exposure
rules.description: Detects mobile apps exposing sensitive data through the system clipboard
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%clipboard%' OR payload ILIKE '%data-exposure%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile — Biometric Authentication Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass biometric authentication on mobile devices
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%biometric%' OR payload ILIKE '%auth-bypass%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile — Screenshot and Screen Recording Detection
rules.description: Detects screen capture or recording while sensitive content is displayed on mobile devices
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%screen-capture%' OR payload ILIKE '%data-theft%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES
